title: Upper density theorem: ν(A ∩ B_r(x))/rⁿ → 0 for Hⁿ-a.e. x outside A
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, E := Ambient n ℓ = ℝ^{n+ℓ} with its Borel σ-algebra, Hⁿ := μHE[n], let ν be a measure on E that is finite on compact sets, and let A ⊆ E be a Borel set. Then for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ E: if x ∉ A, then ν(A ∩ B_r(x))/rⁿ → 0 as r ↓ 0, where B_r(x) is the closed ball and ν(A ∩ B_r(x)) is taken as a real number (ν.real = toReal ∘ ν; it is finite since B_r(x) is compact).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (A : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts ν → MeasurableSet A → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)), x ∉ A → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ ↦ ν.real (A ∩ closedBall x r) / r ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
